role: Biome spawn-list probe: for every registered biome slot, BiomeGenBase.getSpawnableList for the four EnumCreatureTypes after WorldConf.pruneSpawns (what ChunkProviderGenerate.getPossibleCreatures returns outside a swamp hut), plus MapGenScatteredFeature's witch list, as class, weight and group rows.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make run CLASS=BiomeSpawnProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}
csrc/tests/test_biome_spawn.c (out/java/biome_spawn/bs-1), checking csrc/engine/spawning.c's spawning_list_for and spawning_scattered_witch
notes: Reads the registry only; it loads nothing and draws nothing. Slot 161 holds a second object whose biomeID is 160 (a vanilla registry quirk), recorded under both slot and id.
